content: {"episode_id":"ep-05122","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with a history of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) who reports intermittent episodes of palpitations (R00.2) accompanied by dizziness and giddiness (R42). The monitoring was indicated to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease. The documented symptoms and diagnosis support the medical necessity of this diagnostic modality, and we request reconsideration of the CO-50 adjustment."}
